import asyncio

from seed import AsyncSeedApi, Client

client = AsyncSeedApi(
    base_url="https://yourhost.com/path/to/api",
)


async def main() -> None:
    await client.clients.create(
        client=Client(
            name="Acme Corp",
            email="contact@acme.com",
        ),
    )


asyncio.run(main())
